item.title: Marin supervisors reverse course on fire-treated wood
item.description: A regulation adopted in December concerning materials in new construction has now been revised.

item.title: Super Bowl Experience gives fans the chance to get up close with the NFL
item.description: The sprawling San Francisco exhibition, which runs Feb. 3-7, was getting set up on Monday as Super Bowl players and fans started to arrive in the Bay Area.

item.title: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell addresses 49ers’ international future
item.description: The NFL's push for a record nine international games next season could lure in the 49ers for games in Australia and Mexico.

item.title: Marin filmmaker’s short film on fame, social media heads to SF festival
item.description: The film will make its Bay Area debut this week.

item.title: The NFL Experience offers plenty for football fans to enjoy
item.description: Yes, it’ll be crowded. But there’s an unending amount of fascinating, shiny, football stuff inside. It’s likely to be a hassle to get there. But children under 12 are admitted free, and if they are football fans, the kids will enjoy it, as long as it’s not too jam-packed.

item.title: Sports briefs: Cal Poly-bound Chamberlin helps Archie Williams to victory
item.description: Sean Chamberlin found the back of the net a day after announcing his commitment to play for Cal Poly to help lead the Archie Williams High boys soccer team to a 3-0 win against Terra Linda on Monday.

item.title: Slow start, miscues doom Sharks as losing streak reaches three games
item.description: San Jose Sharks allow four second period goals to Chicago Blackhawks as losing streak reaches three games

item.title: Seahawks’ Super Bowl 60 opening night: Darnold compliments 49ers, Seattle at home in Bay
item.description: Receiver Mack Hollins gives his take on theory about electrical substation near Levi's Stadium. Plus, offensive lineman Gray Zabel discusses his unusual childhood chores at Super Bowl media night.

item.title: Bay FC adds ex-West Ham United defender Anouk Denton via transfer
item.description: The 22-year-old once played for new Bay FC head coach Emma Coates in England.

item.title: Now on bigger stage, Sharks have started to wilt: ‘It’s kind of getting to us’
item.description: San Jose Sharks face the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche on Wednesday to finish road trip
